K1.stone_why: Moderate slant keeps the faceted wedge terminals and heavy figures reading as cut stone, only slightly lighter in feel than the upright.
K1.carving_why: Facets on B, p, 6, 2 and 5 are coherent and crisp and the digits are clear, though the kg and x sit a little loosely beside the figures.
K1.calm_why: Measured slant gives a steady forward lean without urgency, with real presence in the title.
K1.personality_why: A recognisable chiselled sloped roman, though it sits close to K2 and K4 in voice.
K1.oblique_why: Even, deliberate angle with steady strokes and spacing; sits comfortably beside the upright with no visible distortion.
K1.fit_emphasis_why: Emphasis words stand out clearly enough at 13 px without jarring the upright colour.
K1.fit_notes_why: Whole lines read smoothly and the Light line holds up, with a slight loss of firmness against K4.
K1.fit_display_why: Title, set weight and capitals are strong and legible; a balanced middle option.

K2.stone_why: Still reads as carved, though the slightly steeper lean begins to loosen the grounded block feel of the figures.
K2.carving_why: Facets stay clean and digits clear; the 6 and 5 hold their cut forms well at the stronger angle.
K2.calm_why: A touch more forward motion than K1; steady but a little more pressing.
K2.personality_why: Slightly more energetic voice than K1, but hard to tell apart from it at a glance.
K2.oblique_why: Consistent angle and spacing with no lopsided letters, a fraction more mechanical-looking in the capitals than K1.
K2.fit_emphasis_why: Emphasis contrast is clear and slightly stronger than K1 without clashing.
K2.fit_notes_why: Notes lines remain readable including Light, with a bit more lean in long runs.
K2.fit_display_why: Display accents feel energetic and bold; set number remains clear.

K3.stone_why: The steepest, slightly heavier slant makes the display figures feel like they are in motion rather than resting carved blocks.
K3.carving_why: Carving is executed crisply and the figures are bold and clear, though the 6 and 2 look slightly dense at the stronger lean.
K3.calm_why: Strong lean and heavier colour read as pushing forward, more restless than the brief's calm register.
K3.personality_why: The most distinct and recognisable oblique of the four, with a clear energetic voice.
K3.oblique_why: The slant is even and deliberate, but its angle and weight diverge most from the upright companion.
K3.fit_emphasis_why: Emphasis words are most clearly distinguished in 13 px running text.
K3.fit_notes_why: Whole lines in this steeper oblique feel busier and lean hard, and the Light line looks more spindly.
K3.fit_display_why: Very bold and energizing for titles and set numbers, at some cost to the grounded stone feel.

K4.stone_why: The gentlest slant keeps the figures and capitals planted and monumental, the closest to carved stone.
K4.carving_why: Facets crisp and coherent, digits very clear; the oblique barely distinguishes the carving from the upright.
K4.calm_why: Very steady and composed, with full presence and no restlessness.
K4.personality_why: So close to upright that the oblique has little voice of its own.
K4.oblique_why: Even, undistorted slant with steady spacing, but so slight that it reads almost as a sloped upright.
K4.fit_emphasis_why: Emphasis words differ too little from the upright at 13 px to stand out reliably.
K4.fit_notes_why: Whole lines and the Light line read calm, firm and comfortable.
K4.fit_display_why: Grounded and legible display accents, though they lose some of the oblique's distinct accent role.
